plugin.plugin_patreon.name: Patreon Linking
plugin.plugin_patreon.description: Patreon tiers become Discord roles: patrons who connected Discord in Patreon get the role of their tier on every server of the bot, automatically and without signing in again. Sync every few minutes plus webhooks, a role for former patrons, announcements of new patrons.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.tiers_hint: Active patrons get the role of every entry they fit: by tier name (as on Patreon) or, without a name, by a minimum monthly amount.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.tiers.tier: e.g. Gold Supporter (no case). Empty: use the minimum amount.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.tiers.min_: In the campaign currency, e.g. 5 for 5 €/$ a month. Only without a tier name.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.former_rol: Optional: ended pledges and declined payments.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.remove_rol: When a pledge ends or changes tier, the roles of the old tier go.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.sync_minut: Reads every patron from Patreon. With the webhook (plugin page) changes come at once in between.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.announce_c: Optional. Not on the very first sync, so existing patrons are not announced.
plugin.plugin_patreon.setting.log_channe: Optional: a line when a patron starts, changes tier or ends.
plugin.plugin_patreon.node.status.label: Patreon pledge
plugin.plugin_patreon.node.status.descri: The pledge of a member from the last sync: status, tiers, amount.
plugin.plugin_patreon.node.sync_now.desc: Starts a full sync of all patrons and their roles now.
